svg.title: IC Blob Storage qualification layers
svg.desc: Four distinct qualification layers progress from native checks of policy and local state, through PocketIC evidence of IC calls and lifecycle under labelled substitutes, to live provider evidence for exact deployments and operations, and finally consumer deployment acceptance for the actual application and operating environment. Each layer needs its own evidence; passing one does not qualify the next. The diagram describes required evidence, not current completion status.

g.text: Each layer answers a different question and requires its own evidence.
Policy, validation and local state behaviour
Qualifies local logic; does not establish IC execution or provider behaviour.
Actual IC calls, lifecycle and transaction rollback under labelled substitutes
Qualifies the local canister composition; does not establish live Caffeine behaviour.
Selected provider operations, serving, retention, deletion and billing observations
Retain exact targets, artefacts, requests and limitations; sample success is scoped evidence.
Actual application integration, deployment, access policy and operational ownership
Qualify the chosen application and environment against the complete acceptance plan.
Required evidence layers · passing one does not qualify the next · this is not a completion report
